aim: Verify authentic 2012–2019 as-of source alternatives BEFORE using broad USD / yield curve to score BTC. Some current FRED series were created in 2014 or 2019; backfilled historical values were not available in this identifier at older dates.

evidence.newBroad: ALFRED DTWEXBGS first original publication 2019-02-04, despite backfilled observations since 2006. Never silently score this series as PIT before 2019.
evidence.olderDollar: ALFRED DTWEXB = goods-only daily dollar index; ALFRED first vintage 2014-03-18, and retired 2020. Only as-of 2014–2019; is NOT identical to current goods+services broad index. Compare 4w direction only and report structural measurement break 2019.
evidence.slope: T10Y2Y series original ALFRED release since 2014-01-27; earlier observation dates in current chart are NOT necessarily as-of index vintages. Try Federal Reserve H15 constituent DGS10 and DGS2 as-of 2012–13; derive slope only if both originally available.
evidence.realYields: DFII10 verified 2013 and later, retain same source.

source: FRED as-of Sunday observations with realtime_start=end Sunday, previous 65d daily (or weekly TWEXB) and log/sha store. Source NOT AVAILABLE before first as-of real publication must be distinguished from API failures.
validity: accept >=3 numeric observations and latest age 2-10 calendar days (weekly TWEXB <=14d). Calculate 4wk delta from earliest value 25-35 days before latest. Never use backfilled modern reconstructed prior release.
limit: Original source vintage not intraday verified, weekly derivatives may differ across source changes, and any methodological index splice must be flagged.
storage: Versioned official raw R2 with SHA readback report manifest; unchanged previous original pilot v8.18a
